errors.where: X-shaped side leg frames, where the tubes cross
errors.what: The crossing leg tubes have no pivot bolt or rivet where they cross. They just pass by each other, so the chair could not fold or lock in place.

cards.fix: folding camp chair with a visible pivot rivet where each pair of crossed side legs meet

errors.where: underside of the lamp body, bottom center
errors.what: A short pipe sticks out of the bottom of the housing. It is not connected to anything and does no job on a stage light.

cards.fix: stage spotlight with a smooth closed underside, no pipe sticking out below the housing

errors.what: The bass drum has no kick pedal, so nothing could play it.

cards.fix: drum kit with a kick pedal clamped to the bottom rim of the bass drum

errors.where: strap ends on both flip-flops, especially the long right arm
errors.what: The strap arms end in flat cut-off tabs that hang above the sole edge. They are not anchored into the sole, so the strap could not hold a foot.
Both flip-flops have the same sole outline and strap layout, so they are two of the same foot instead of a mirrored left and right pair.

cards.fix: pair of mirrored left and right flip-flops, each Y strap with both side ends plugged into the side edges of the sole

errors.where: red seat on the duck's back
errors.what: The handle stands in the middle of the seat, so a child could not sit there. On a real spring rider the handles are in front of the seat.
There are no footrests, which spring riders have.

cards.fix: duck spring rider with the red saddle on its back, handlebars on the neck in front of the saddle, and footrests on both sides of the body
